Human sensing, made human

A living light room that meets you where you are.

LumaPause is a private pre-performance ritual. In the desktop app, breathing, pulse, and visible expression patterns gently shape light and motion—without scores, diagnoses, or stored video.

Run the desktop app

General wellness and reflection only. Not medical advice.

Responsive light · no clinical score
A meaningful response

Your signals shape the room.

The desktop experience uses SmartSpectra on-device processing. Each available signal has one bounded, understandable visual effect; missing or uncertain signals fall back to ambient motion rather than invented readings.

01

Breathing becomes space

Chest movement shapes the central field. Breathing rate adjusts its visible tempo and the drift of surrounding particles.

02

Pulse becomes light

Pulse influences a subtle ring glow. The animation is deliberately clamped and never flashes at literal heart rate.

03

Expression becomes warmth

With separate consent, visible expression probabilities nudge the palette between mint and amber—never a categorical claim about emotion.

Consent before sensing

Private by design, precise in its claims.

The desktop app computes measurements locally with SmartSpectra. Presage is contacted for API-key and subscription validation; LumaPause never claims that every byte stays offline.

✓
Camera starts only after consent

No automatic capture, covert monitoring, or background sessions.

✓
Frames are never recorded

Camera frames and metric samples remain in memory for the current session and are cleared on finish.

✓
No medical interpretation

No stress score, diagnosis, treatment claim, identity inference, or consequential decision-making.

✓
Uncertainty stays visible

Stale, missing, and low-confidence signals are labeled honestly and never replaced with fake live values.

Genuine sensing lives on desktop

Run the desktop Electron build.

The full application integrates SmartSpectra’s native Node runtime through a secure Electron main/preload/renderer boundary. Set SMARTSPECTRA_API_KEY, install dependencies, and run the desktop app to use a supported camera. Live hardware verification still requires a valid key and physical camera.

Review data handling
npm install
$env:SMARTSPECTRA_API_KEY="your-key"
npm run dev
